cases.title: Two CSV participants complete one round and publish a digest-verified model
prerequisites: An existing deployment and ready participant data manifest with exactly two distinct runtime identities
Both MANUAL_GUIDED agents have reported reachable endpoints
CSV dataset capability and platform metadata are ready for both participants
Training configuration uses linear.LogisticRegression, maxRounds=1 and minimumNodesPerRound=2
Required sklearn training and aggregation images are available; artifact endpoints are reachable from the test worker

dataRequirements.description: Two distinct organizations, runtime identities and dataset bindings from the data manifest
Synthetic test.csv: 32 rows, id plus three numeric features and binary readmission_risk; accessible in both worker nodes at /workspace/datasets/test.csv
